title: Import a preserved DOS image into an owned Ghidra project and emit a structural receipt
description: Run the deterministic Ghidra import driver against one stored DOS executable with an explicit processor language, then emit the JSON receipt. Record the input SHA-256, resolved language, Ghidra and Java identity, memory-block model, per-stage timings and the reopen check. Do not analyse semantics, publish listings, or interpret function boundaries.
candidate_note: Prepared for coordination with the concurrent Supervisor campaign. Not registered for dispatch; this campaign does not own Supervisor resources.

limits.analysis: disabled by default; pass --analyze only when a task needs autoanalysis
limits.cpu: one core per import; the analyzer's -max-cpu applies only to analyzeHeadless

cancellation.resulting_state: unknown; the owned project must be discarded and the receipt marked failed, never treated as partial success

cache.invalidate_on: any key change; a receipt missing a key component is not cacheable

acceptance: The receipt records the input size and SHA-256 and they match the request.
The resolved language id is read back from the imported program, not echoed from the request.
Memory-block records and stage timings are present.
When --reopen-check is requested, the reopen runs in a separate process and reports the same language and block count.
No original input file is modified; the project directory was created or exclusively owned by this run.
exclusions: no emulator, guest or VMware resource
no publication of listings, decompiled output or proprietary bytes
no semantic conclusion: function names, xrefs and decompiler types are tool output, not evidence
